post.originalText:
Good morning builders ☕

Yesterday was my Claude weekly reset.

Opus 5.5 is surprisingly cheap compared to 5 when you scope things properly.

Still had 40% of my weekly usage left.

So naturally, I went:

"Build me a massive new feature for Loudship."

"And while you're at it, make some videos for Rawnd."

Can't let those tokens go to waste 😂

Anyone else go crazy right before their weekly reset?
